title: Flowers

audio.transcript: Earlier this year, I was driving through the countryside with a girl of six, and she pointed out some flowers by the wayside. I asked her what she thought flowers were for. She gave a very thoughtful answer. "Two things," she said, "to make the world pretty and to help the bees make honey for us."
